clips.scene_text: Ek dafa ka zikr hai, ek baaz (eagle) ka anda ghalti se ek khet me murgiyon (chickens) ke ghonsle me gir gaya
Jab anda toota, toh usme se baaz ka bacha nikla
Lekin kyunke wo murgiyon ke beech paida hua tha, usne khud ko bhi ek aam murgi samajh liya
Wo zameen par daana chugta, sirf kuch fit tak udta, aur bilkul murgiyon jaisi aawazein nikalta
Usne kabhi ooncha udne ka socha hi nahi
Ek din, usne asmaan me ek bohot bade aur shandaar parinday ko baadalon ka seena cheerte hue udte dekha

Usne hairat se paas khadi ek murgi se poocha, 'Wo shandaar parinda kaun hai?'

Murgi ne hanste hue kaha, 'Wo asmaan ka raja, Baaz hai
Lekin tum uski tarah nahi ud sakte, kyunke tum ek murgi ho

'

Baaz ke us bache ne is baat ko sach maan liya
Usne apni poori zindagi zameen par ek murgi ban kar guzaar di, aur kabhi apne asli pankh nahi phailaye
Lesson: Aapki zindagi wahi banti hai jo aap khud ke baare me sochte hain
Agar aap apne aas-paas ke aam logon ki baatein sun kar apne khwabon ko chota kar lenge, toh aap kabhi apni asli taqat nahi pehchan payenge
Asmaan me udna hai, toh zameen par chalne walon ki soch se bahar nikalna hoga
